faq.question: What does this HTML to JSON converter do?
faq.answer: It extracts HTML table rows and columns and converts them into a JSON array of objects. Each table row becomes one object, and the detected headers become property names.

faq.question: Can I convert a complete HTML page to JSON?
faq.answer: This page extracts tables only. Everything outside a table element is ignored, because most page markup does not map to rows and columns. It does not fetch a URL and does not convert an entire page into a JSON document.

faq.question: How are table headers detected?
faq.answer: Detect header row uses the first row inside thead, or a leading row whose cells are all th elements. First row is header forces the first row to be used. No header row generates column_1, column_2, and so on.

faq.question: What if the HTML contains multiple tables?
faq.answer: The number of tables found is displayed, and you can pick which one to convert. Tables nested inside a cell are counted too and can be selected on their own.

faq.question: Can I convert an HTML table without a header row?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose No header row and the converter generates column_1, column_2, column_3, and so on. Generated names work, but they are less descriptive than real headers.

faq.question: Does it support rowspan and colspan?
faq.answer: No. This version does not expand cells that span several positions, because doing so requires a grid-expansion algorithm. When a colspan or rowspan attribute greater than 1 is found, the page warns you so the column alignment can be checked manually.

faq.question: What happens to duplicate or empty header names?
faq.answer: An empty header becomes column_N for its position, and a repeated name gets a numeric suffix such as Name_2, so no column is silently dropped. Both cases raise a warning.

faq.question: Does it preserve HTML inside table cells?
faq.answer: No. Cell text content is extracted, so tags such as a, strong, and span inside a cell contribute their text only. Markup inside cells is not kept, and there is no option to preserve it.

faq.question: Does it infer numbers and booleans?
faq.answer: Only when Infer basic types is enabled, and only for a narrow set of values: lowercase true and false become booleans, and plain integers or decimals become numbers. Values such as 00123, SKU-001, 1e5, and TRUE stay strings, so keep the option off when identifiers or formatted amounts must remain text.

faq.question: What happens to empty and missing cells?
faq.answer: A missing cell becomes an empty string, or null when Convert empty cells to null is enabled. Rows with a different number of cells than the header are still converted and are reported as a warning.

faq.question: Can I extract table data from a URL?
faq.answer: No. Fetching a URL introduces CORS limits, remote-content and privacy concerns, and does not work for pages rendered by JavaScript. Paste the HTML or open a local file instead.

faq.question: Can I convert HTML attributes to JSON?
faq.answer: No. Only cell text content is extracted. Attributes such as class, href, src, and data-* values are not converted, and there is no attribute mapping option.

faq.question: Can I convert HTML to a JSON DOM tree?
faq.answer: No. This page converts tables into JSON records. A DOM tree mode that represents tags, attributes, text, and children is not available.

faq.question: Is HTML to JSON the same as scraping a website?
faq.answer: No. This tool parses HTML you supply. Scraping a website usually means fetching URLs, running JavaScript, handling pagination, and respecting access policies, none of which this page does.

faq.question: Can I convert JSON back to HTML?
faq.answer: Use the JSON to HTML page for the reverse direction. A JSON array of objects can be rendered back into rows and columns.

faq.question: Can I convert a large HTML file?
faq.answer: The practical limit depends on document size, number of tables, DOM complexity, browser memory, and preview rendering. Large pages may be better handled with a local parser.

faq.question: Is my HTML uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. The page parses HTML and generates JSON in your browser. You should still avoid pasting private customer data, authenticated page content, credentials, or confidential HTML into any browser-based tool.

faq.question: Is this a free HTML to JSON converter?
faq.answer: Yes. You can paste or open HTML, extract table data, review the result, and copy or download JSON without creating an account.

article.title: How to Convert an HTML Table to JSON
article.content:
What Is HTML Table to JSON Conversion?

HTML Table to JSON conversion parses HTML markup and represents table data as JSON. The usual result is an array of objects: each table row becomes one object, and each column becomes a property.

This is different from representing a whole document as a JSON DOM tree with tags, attributes, text, and children. This page extracts tables only; it does not serialize an entire page.

How to Convert an HTML Table to JSON

  1. Enter HTML: paste markup containing a table, or open a local .html or .htm file.
  2. Pick the table: when several tables are present, select the one you need.
  3. Detect headers: use th cells, force the first row, or generate column names.
  4. Configure values: trim text, infer basic types, or turn empty cells into null.
  5. Review warnings: check spans, renamed headers, and uneven rows.
  6. Convert: generate a JSON array of objects.
  7. Copy or download: save the result as a .json file.

Example HTML Table

Input:

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr><th>Name</th><th>Age</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>Alice</td><td>30</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

Output with the default options:

[
  {"Name":"Alice","Age":"30"}
]

Age stays the string "30" because type inference is off by default. Turn it on to get the number 30.

Header Handling

Column names can come from an explicit thead section, from a leading row of th cells, or from generated names. When a header cell is empty it becomes column_N for that position, and a repeated name gets a numeric suffix such as Name_2, so no column is silently dropped. Both cases are reported as a warning.

If a table has more than one header row, this page uses the first one and warns you, because grouped or stacked headings cannot be flattened unambiguously.

Why colspan and rowspan Matter

A cell with colspan="2" occupies two logical positions, and rowspan spans several rows. Correctly expanding them requires building a grid and filling every position a spanning cell covers. This version does not do that: it reads each row as written and warns when a span is present, so the column alignment can be checked by hand instead of being silently wrong.

Text Content, Not HTML

Values are read from cell text content. Tags inside a cell contribute their text, so <td><strong>Alice</strong></td> yields Alice. Markup and attributes such as href or src are not extracted. That keeps the output plain data, and it also means links and images inside a table are not part of the result.

Type Inference Can Change Values

Table cells are text, and text has no type. With inference enabled, lowercase true and false become booleans and plain integers or decimals become numbers. Values such as 00123, SKU-001, 1e5, and TRUE are never converted, so identifiers, postal codes, and formatted amounts stay intact. Keep the option off unless numeric types are what you need.

HTML to JSON Is Not Scraping

This tool parses HTML that you paste or open locally. It does not fetch URLs, run JavaScript, follow pagination, or evaluate access policies. For repeated extraction from live sites, a local scraper or a build-time step is the right tool; the browser converter is for saved markup, copied fragments, and one-off extraction.

Privacy and Browser-Based Processing

Parsing and conversion happen in the browser, so the HTML you paste stays on your device. That suits saved pages and exported markup, but it is not a secret-management system. Avoid pasting authenticated page content, credentials, or confidential customer data into any online tool.

When to Use a Local Parser

For many files, repeated jobs, very large documents, or confidential content, use a local HTML parser and keep the conversion in your own pipeline. Browser conversion is best for quick extraction, inspection, and small-to-medium tables.

faq.question: HTML 里有多个表格怎么办？

faq.question: 没有表头行的表格能转换吗？

faq.question: 支持 rowspan 和 colspan 吗？

faq.question: 表头名重复或为空会怎样？

faq.question: 会保留单元格里的 HTML 吗？

faq.question: 会推断数字和布尔值吗？

article.title: 如何把 HTML 表格转换成 JSON
article.content:
什么是 HTML 表格转 JSON

HTML 表格转 JSON 是解析 HTML 标记并把表格数据表示为 JSON。通常的结果是一个对象数组：每个表格行成为一个对象，每一列成为一个属性。

这和把整个文档表示成含标签、属性、文本和子节点的 JSON DOM 树不同。本页只提取表格，不会序列化整个页面。

如何把 HTML 表格转成 JSON

  1. 输入 HTML：粘贴含表格的标记，或打开本地 .html、.htm 文件。
  2. 选择表格：存在多个表格时，选中你需要的那个。
  3. 识别表头：用 th 单元格、强制第一行，或生成列名。
  4. 配置取值：去除文本空白、推断基础类型，或把空单元格转成 null。
  5. 查看提示：检查合并单元格、表头重命名和行不齐。
  6. 转换：生成 JSON 对象数组。
  7. 复制或下载：把结果保存为 .json 文件。

HTML 表格示例

输入：

<table>
  <thead>
    <tr><th>Name</th><th>Age</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>Alice</td><td>30</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

默认选项下的输出：

[
  {"Name":"Alice","Age":"30"}
]

因为类型推断默认关闭，Age 保持字符串 "30"。开启后会得到数字 30。

表头处理

列名可以来自显式的 thead 区块、开头的 th 单元格行，或自动生成的名字。表头单元格为空时按位置变成 column_N；重复的名字会加上数字后缀，例如 Name_2，因此不会有列被悄悄丢掉。这两种情况都会给出提示。

如果表格有多行表头，本页使用第一行并给出提示，因为分组或堆叠的表头无法无歧义地扁平化。

为什么 colspan 和 rowspan 很重要

colspan="2" 的单元格占两个逻辑位置，rowspan 跨多行。要正确展开它们，需要建立网格并填充被跨越的每个位置。本版本不做这件事：它按原始写法读取每一行，发现跨行列属性时给出提示，让你手动核对列对齐，而不是给出看似正确实则错位的结果。

取文本内容，不是 HTML

取值来自单元格的文本内容。单元格里的标签只贡献文本，所以 <td><strong>Alice</strong></td> 得到 Alice。标记和 href、src 这类属性不会被提取。这让输出保持为纯数据，也意味着表格里的链接和图片不会出现在结果中。

类型推断会改变值

表格单元格是文本，文本没有类型。开启推断后，小写的 true 和 false 变成布尔值，整数或小数变成数字。00123、SKU-001、1e5、TRUE 都不会被转换，所以编号、邮编和带格式金额能保持原样。除非确实需要数值类型，否则请保持关闭。

HTML 转 JSON 不是爬虫

本工具解析的是你粘贴或本地打开的 HTML，不会抓取 URL、执行 JavaScript、处理分页或判断访问权限。需要反复从线上站点提取时，应该用本地爬虫或构建阶段的处理；浏览器转换器适合处理已保存的标记、复制的片段和一次性提取。

隐私与浏览器本地处理

解析和转换都在浏览器里完成，粘贴的 HTML 留在你的设备上。这适合已保存的页面和导出的标记，但它不是密钥管理系统。不要把登录后的页面内容、凭证或客户机密数据粘贴到任何在线工具里。

什么时候改用本地解析器
